standard_prerequisites.use: Finite-length modules over a local ring, determinant lines and their exact-sequence/symmetry conventions, connecting maps of short exact sequences of periodic complexes. The periodic determinant and its admissible-sequence description are included explicitly.

core_obligations: Identify both connecting isomorphismsQ toK and choose compatible admissible sequences for the kernels, images and quotient of the two exact periodic complexes.
Compare the determinant-line expressions with the induced quotient automorphism, retaining the permutation signs to obtain the precise multiplicative ratio.

difficulty_reason: The needed identity compares two exact periodic structures through a morphism with zero-action kernel and cokernel; it requires a coordinated choice of lifts and determinant signs, not just multiplicativity in one short exact sequence. The detailed source comparison supplies H2 obligations.
